title: Add logbook import/export and improve flight altitude and vario analysis
body:
Pilots can keep a complete logbook in Leaf Log, including flights without recordings, and download their flight history and original IGC files. Manual entry supports place search and separate flying-site and landing pins. This PR also simplifies logbook filters, improves responsive layouts and copy, and fixes XC searches that previously discarded unfinished work.

Flight analysis now aligns barometric altitude to GPS consistently across the profile and 3D replay, uses GPS for altitude records, and preserves short climb/sink peaks when the recorder has no VAR field.

## Changes

- Add manual flight entry and CSV import with column/unit mapping, name normalization, duplicate review, import receipts, and undo that preserves subsequently changed flights. Allow attaching an IGC to an existing entry after comparing measurements.
- Add city, landmark, and known-site search to the manual-entry map. Search moves the map without changing flight details; clicking sets the selected location. Flying-site pins are blue and landing pins are orange, with both locations kept visible.
- Include unrecorded flights and reported XC results in totals and personal bests while keeping replay and recorded analysis limited to flights with recordings. Use the owning profile for pilot identity and show original recording details separately.
- Place Import and Export side by side in Settings. Owner-only CSV and raw IGC ZIP exports include the full logbook regardless of filters. CSV filenames match ZIP entries and individual downloads; original bytes are preserved and downloads stream one recording at a time.
- Keep All/None selections for sites and wings. Selecting friends shows their shared flights; clearing the selection restores all flights. Trophies is a single on/off filter. Put date Clear at the top of its dropdown and Clear filters above the controls so the layout stays stable. Preserve filter choices through navigation.
- Refine responsive trophies, flight rows, and shared UI states. Render the upload introduction as plain text to preserve spaces around .igc file, and correct singular/plural counts, punctuation, capitalization, and wording across the UI.
- Continue unfinished XC optimization across scoring slices while retaining the existing overall worker limits.
- Calibrate baro once per flight with the median GPS-minus-baro difference from valid paired fixes. Use the same corrected altitude for profile, replay geometry, and readouts, with GPS fallback for missing baro. Remove terrain-based altitude offsets and pilot-height clamps for selected and companion tracks.
- Preserve legitimate zero-altitude crossings; treat only an entirely zero-valued channel as unavailable. Use valid GPS altitude exclusively for maximum-altitude and launch-gain records, leaving those records unavailable when GPS is missing.
- Replace layered no-VAR smoothing and replay's eight-second window with one centred four-second altitude difference calculated on original fixes before replay downsampling. Interpolate window endpoints for irregular sampling, shorten at segment boundaries, and avoid bridging recording gaps or missing altitude. Recorded VAR values retain precedence; cumulative-gain smoothing remains separate.
- Add FEATURES.md follow-ups for potential terrain adjustment and verification of the GPS altitude reference exported by Leaf firmware.

## Validation

- TypeScript passed. ESLint completed with no errors; one warning is confined to an untracked local artifact script.
- Full Vitest suite passed: 703 tests across 82 files, including GPS/baro alignment, zero crossings, GPS-only records, four-second peaks, sparse/irregular fixes, recording gaps, VAR precedence, and persisted repair artifacts.
- Production build passed with `NEXT_TURBOPACK_EXPERIMENTAL_USE_SYSTEM_TLS_CERTS=1` to permit Google Fonts downloads in the local environment.
- Earlier logbook validation: six Playwright tests passed covering filter persistence, desktop/mobile CSV and ZIP export, map search and both location pins, coordinate persistence, manual entry and IGC attachment, CSV review and undo, and preservation of original recording details.
- Earlier browser checks verify the exact upload introduction and absence of nested formatting, plus layouts from 320 to 768 pixels. Live MapTiler city search and known-site search were also checked locally.

## Deployment

Apply Prisma migration `20260910020000_logbook_entries` before deploying the application. It adds logbook import metadata and recording/reporting fields, and makes the IGC hash nullable for unrecorded entries. Existing flights retain the `igc` recording kind.

Place search reuses `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY` in the browser. Without a key, known-site search remains available. Provider results are used for map navigation and are not persisted.

IGC filenames use the flight date and unique ID because original upload filenames are not stored.

Replay artifact, parser, and metrics versions are bumped. Cached replay artifacts rebuild on access. Existing stored flight statistics and altitude records must be reprocessed using **Repair flight data** (available individually or in bulk from the logbook); original IGC bytes and pilot edits are preserved. No terrain or geoid correction is applied.
